name: packaging-config
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the framework adopts a different distribution channel than a self-hosted Claude Code plugin marketplace, or when later slices fold this into a full configure/run UX feature.
spec_change_reason: Cut release v0.27.0 (minor, stylish-configure lib re-ship): bump _PLUGIN_VERSION 0.26.0 -> 0.27.0 and regenerate the committed plugin tree so it carries safety-governance 0.17.0's configure.py (human-readable render_config --show view by default, a new --json machine escape, and issue_filter.exclude_labels promoted into the field catalog). The shipped default-config CONTENT is unchanged (still schema 2.9.0, same values); this release only re-normalizes lib/configure.py from the merged source and stamps plugin.json + marketplace.json to 0.27.0. The version-assertion test advanced to 0.27.0, test/release_lib_baseline.json re-anchored (version -> 0.27.0, lib_digest -> the new committed-lib digest since the shipped lib bytes changed), and test/housekeep_doc_baseline.json re-anchored (spec.md 353 -> 364 for the v0.27.0 release note) so the drift, #355 monotonicity, and doc-no-growth guards stay green.
spec_no_change_reason: Spec already advanced to 0.7.17 (v0.27.0 release note) in commit bb36e5e at cycle start; this release cut carries no further spec surface beyond the _PLUGIN_VERSION bump.
